title: Unrestricted strict-henselization stalk formula
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $F$ be an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $S_{(\bar x)}=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{S,\bar x}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let $p:X\times_S S_{(\bar x)}\to X$ be the projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $q\geq0$, the canonical restriction map $(R^q f_*F)_{\bar x}\to H^q((X\times_S S_{(\bar x)})_{\mathrm{Et}},p^{-1}F)$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].
